sources.name: YouGov single favorite topping (pepperoni 24, sausage 13, extra cheese 11, mushrooms 9, chicken 6). Top 5 only

changes_vs_current: Top 3 unchanged. Bacon moves up (6 to 4) and Onions (5 to 5); Extra Cheese falls from 4 to 6. Ham, Pineapple, Spinach and Tomatoes are placed by data. Chicken is placed at 12 (it is 5th in one YouGov poll). Ranks 14-24 are NOT data-ranked: no source I could read covers them. The Ranker pizza-topping list (13.3K voters, 215K votes) exists but returned 401 and could not be read, and I'm not citing it. Ranks 14-24 are the current list's tail with Meatballs moved up (3% favorite in YouGov 2023, per The Takeout) and Anchovies and Artichokes moved to the bottom (most disliked in YouGov 2021).
confidence: medium-low. Only the top ~13 are evidence-based. Four sources, but each shows only the top 5-10, and two of those 10-deep lists are second-hand reproductions. Ranks 14-24 are unverified filler. A Datassential/PMQ 2025 menu-penetration report (onions on 77% of pizzeria menus) was found but measures what is on menus, not preference, so it is excluded.
